answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 5 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 56 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. A crystal of doubt is healthy, a violet of proof is required, and a canyon of patience is the price of a clean panel.
